description: Return a read-only overview of the planned VPS package/configuration change: current vs. target resources, pricing (recurring old/new, delta, immediate charges or credits, billing period), blockers, migration requirements, and a one-time previewConfirmationNonce when allowed. Read-only. Never call apply_* in the same assistant turn. After preview, you MUST send a user-visible message that includes old price, new price, delta, and immediate charge or credit from confirmation.pricingSummary. Then STOP and wait for an explicit user reply (for example 'Ja') in a NEW turn. A user request like 'upgrade to 3 GB' only authorizes preview, not apply. Pass couponCode only when the user gave you a coupon code for this upgrade (never guess or invent one): an accepted code is shown as pricing.couponCode / pricing.couponDiscountCents and is already subtracted from the immediate charge; a refused code makes the preview not allowed with coupon.error -- tell the user why and preview again without the code if they want to continue.

couponCode.description: Optional shop coupon code the user typed for this upgrade. Only pass a code the user explicitly gave you in this conversation; never guess, invent, reuse from elsewhere or try codes. It only reduces the amount charged now for an upgrade (pricing.couponDiscountCents, coupon.error when refused). Apply must send exactly the same couponCode as the preview whose nonce it uses.

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

pricingMode.description: Set "custom" to change cores, memoryMb, diskGb or bandwidthMbps on a package VPS (otherwise the request is rejected); use targetPackageKey to switch package.
